activity_summary: You sat at James Burbage's long table with the fellows, Kemp not yet in. The streets up had been swept and silent, and the gate had looked at every face. John said the almanac says no play, and that the afternoon bill was struck this morning. You began the forty leaves. At the hollow crown you read the two lines, and Dick's hand went flat on the table and stayed. You did not take the hand away. The harder page is still ahead of you. Nothing has been agreed yet except to hear the king out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the forty leaves and began to read every voice.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Asked what was brought, and left his hand flat at the hollow crown.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Named the almanac and the struck afternoon, and told the reading to go on.

entities.name: James Burbage
entities.context: Shut the door, and heard a king at his table without calling it a play.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Noted Saturday's second lock, and that Kemp was not yet in.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Called the table the Monday you had agreed to meet, and kept you reading.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Mentioned in Every voice, at the long table

facets.activity: Began the king and Dick's hand stayed flat on the table

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: For Gods sake let vs sit vpon the ground

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Quieter, and empty of a play at two. The almanac says no play

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Leave thy hand out of it. No. Leave mine. I am not done with the line;
